Provides generated bincode encode/decode, size, walk, and tree map helpers for Solana data types.

# Purpose
This code is a generated C serialization layer for Solana-related data types. It defines `encode`, `decode`, `decode_footprint`, `size`, `new`, and `walk` functions for many structs and tagged unions, and it uses the `fd_bincode` API to convert in-memory data to and from the wire format. The code covers fixed-size types, optional fields, variable-length arrays, deques, offset-based `*_global` forms, and union types with `discriminant` fields and `fd_*_is_*` helpers. It also provides generic traversal through `fd_types_walk_fn_t` and includes a red-black tree map for `fd_clock_timestamp_vote_t` entries, so other code can inspect, size, allocate, and decode protocol objects such as transaction state, vote state, sysvars, instructions, and related account data.
